grading_rules: Canon = stated in the evidence as part of the lore from Games Workshop / Black Library publications. Conflicting = the evidence notes contradictory accounts, retcons, or unreliable in-universe narrators (40K contradicts itself on purpose; say so). Legends = superseded older-edition lore the evidence marks as such. Fan theory = popular interpretation the evidence does not confirm. Unsupported = no evidence card says it. (Lexicanum was the first choice but is behind a bot wall, so we use the Fandom wiki.) Grade canon STATUS, not paraphrase: hedged or multiply-told events are Conflicting. Interpretation = history-to-fiction parallels and narrator framing.
